thread:
Maya P: quick sync on trace drilldown UX after last round of usability tests. Main issues: copy for export/download, correlation id discoverability, long stack traces, and keyboard/accessibility of the action menu. Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc

Samir K: reading the test notes. recommendation: correlation id should be first-class (copy pill + link), then a single prominent action. hide extras in kebab. aria-labels on every action.

Toni L: microcopy question: primary CTA  'Download error bundle' vs 'Export trace'. Test users said "bundle" felt more accurate because it includes logs + spans. I vote for "Download error bundle" to set expectations.

Olivia R: product preference: keep Console terminology consistent. we use "Export" for small tabular exports, "Download" for packaged artifacts. go with "Download error bundle". add small helper text listing files.

Maya P: proposed header layout: [Error icon] Error 	 correlation: ab12cd34 [Copy]. under: summary row (time, route, user: ****). primary CTA: "Download error bundle". kebab items: "Open in Log Viewer", "Copy Trace Link", "Export Spans (JSON)", "Open full trace".

Samir K: ordering for keyboard users: first kebab item should be "Copy Trace Link" so hitting Enter activates it immediately. add keyboard shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C to copy correlation id when trace panel focused. include aria-describedby that lists bundle contents.

Toni L: copy nits for download dialog: heading suggestion: "Download error bundle 	 includes spans.json, logs.log, request_headers.json". kebab verbs: "Open in Log Viewer", "Copy Trace Link", "Export Spans (JSON)" (use imperative verbs for clarity).

Maya P: accessibility issues from testing: 1) screen reader pronounced "copy button" twice on the pill 2) huge stacks overwhelm SR users; default collapse with ability to expand specific frame 3) Up/Down to move span focus + Enter to toggle expand.

DesignBot: suggested checklist: - set aria-live="polite" on copy toast - ensure download modal traps focus - add skip-to-frames link target for SRs - render span list with role="list" and items as role="listitem" - provide focus-visible styles for pill and actions

Samir K: perf note: some traces have thousands of spans. virtualize the span list, persist expand state only for visible items. debounce expand animations to avoid main-thread jank.

Toni L: microcopy variants for the download modal: Option A title: "Download error bundle" body: "Package includes: spans.json, logs.log, request_headers.json" CTA: "Download". Option B title: "Export trace artifact" body: "Includes spans and raw logs 	 for debugging and sharing." CTA: "Export". which is clearer to support engineers?

Olivia R: Option A. explicit filenames reduce confusion in support tickets. add a security note: "Contains sensitive headers; share only with authorized parties."

Maya P: layout debate: side panel vs full-screen modal for trace drilldown. side panel less disruptive, but narrow for long frames. test results: ~60% liked side panel for triage, 40% wanted full-screen for deep code view. compromise: default side panel + "Open full trace" action preserved in kebab.

Samir K: agree. add an inline "Open full trace" so users keep context. deep link pattern: /traces/:id?span=:span_id to jump directly to a frame. make sure link includes short form of correlation id for readability.

Toni L: keyboard flow for side panel I sketched: global T opens trace with focus; Tab order: header 	 correlation pill 	 primary CTA 	 kebab 	 span list; Up/Down to move spans; Enter toggles frame; Shift+Enter expands all frames in selected span. I added a small diagram in Figma.

Maya P: tooltip copy for correlation pill: current draft "Correlation ID 	 click to copy link to this trace". too verbose?

Olivia R: shorter is better: tooltip "Copy trace link". pill should show truncated id (first 8 / last 4) and on hover show full id + hint "Press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C".

DesignBot: tooltip accessibility: ensure tooltip target has aria-describedby and is keyboard focusable. tooltips must not be the only way to convey info.

Samir K: stack frame interactions: show file:line on line-number hover and provide a small copy icon that copies "file:line" context, not entire frame. also add "Copy stack" action to copy a readable stack for support tickets.

Toni L: export UX detail: when user selects "Export Spans (JSON)", show ephemeral dropdown: options [Visible spans, All spans, Time range...] default to Visible spans to avoid huge exports.

Maya P: infra asks for bundle schema so backend can stream ZIP parts. suggested filenames: spans.json, logs.log, request_headers.json, metadata.json. Also flag for Dedicated/Private to redact headers by default.

InfraBot: noted. will expose an API param redact_headers=true by default for Private. backend will stream as zip entries, metadata.json contains trace id, timestamp, truncated user id.

Olivia R: add release note: "trace drilldown: improved copy, accessible keyboard nav, download bundle with explicit file list, side panel default + open full trace". schedule for next patch.

Maya P: next steps: 1) update Figma with copy + side-panel + full-screen flows 2) write keyboard nav doc and aria spec 3) handoff virtualized span list implementation notes to eng. will @Samir for ARIA reviews.

Samir K: Ill review ARIA bits. also add unit tests for copy toast aria-live and ensure no double announcement for copy pill.

Maya P: thanks everyone. will follow up with a short 6-user re-test next week and post results here. :thumbsup:
